slot_scores.name: max_shifts_per_week
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Does the constraint "each student can work no more than 2 shifts per week" mean that a student can be scheduled on at most 2 different days per week, or does it mean something else?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the limit on shifts/working days per student per week, directly matching the slot's semantic hit rule.

slot_scores.name: max_students_per_day
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Does the constraint "no more than 3 different students can be scheduled for duty on any single day" mean that at most 3 students can have non-zero hours on that day, or does it refer to something else?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether there is a daily cap on the count of distinct students assigned to duty, matching the slot's semantic hit rule.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_gross_pay
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the objective of the scheduling plan: minimize total weekly labor cost, minimize total hours worked, or something else?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and offered minimizing labor cost, matching the slot's semantic hit rule.

stopping_behavior.rationale: All P0/P1 hidden slots (H1, H2, H3) were explicitly resolved before READY_TO_MODEL. The later repeated questions (turns 13-16) concern non-hidden modeling details (hour granularity, continuity, student classification, weekly max) that the simulator would not confirm, so they do not constitute unresolved hidden slots.

summary: The agent directly surfaced the objective (H3) and clarified both business-rule constraints on weekly days worked (H1) and distinct students per day (H2) before modeling, though it initially relied on a broad catch-all for the two shift/daily limits. No hidden slot was left as a silent assumption, and the agent stopped only after the P0/P1 slots were resolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
